sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Unique-values dropdown "Event info - Event cancelled"/"Entity info - Event cancelled" entry (e.g. `/user/<username>/ratings/event`, `artist-events`, `place-events`, `area-events`, `tag-value`/`user-tag-value`): now renders in red, reusing MusicBrainz's own native `.cancelled` CSS class — matching the "(cancelled)" marker's own red styling in the "Event" column cell instead of plain text.
